verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents general Files API actions (create, read, edit, move, delete) and explicit retention windows for restoring deleted content (30/180/365 days depending on plan), which implies some revision/version retention capability, but no evidence pack item explicitly documents dedicated version-history endpoints (e.g., list_revisions/restore) or their API usage pattern for revisions specifically. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a revisions-listing endpoint, explicit documentation of a restore-specific-revision endpoint, and hands-on/independent confirmation that these work as described.
